build_model_components: build a PyTorch model with source and target embeddings, a linear mapping layer, and optional discriminator
create_discriminator_network: create a multi-layer discriminator network with LeakyReLU activations and sigmoid output for adversarial training
run_discriminator_forward: run the discriminator forward pass on a 2D embedding tensor to get real/fake probability scores
review_discriminator_init: review the Discriminator class constructor to configure layers, hidden dimensions, and dropout rates
test_build_model_identity_mapping: test the build_model function to verify the mapping layer initializes as an identity matrix
